verdict.rationale: Sierra documents pre-release testing: Simulations and Agent Checks catch problems proactively, and scenario-based verification guards against regressions. Merge approvals and split-traffic releases gate changes before full production rollout. However, nothing describes an isolated sandbox environment or keeping test runs away from production data and live systems. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment, documented isolation of test runs from production data and integrations, mocked tool/API backends, independent or hands-on corroboration.
